prose: Marty Leeds has manifested a mathmagical ministry over the last year with his work at the Gnostic Academy of Lord Jesus Christ, with anagogical analysis that enlivens the Bible by demonstrating the stellar origins of the myths it retells. Tonight we'll be exploring details from his new book, Scripture in the Stars, and learning more about the astrotheology encoded in the Christian mysteries.
